facts: Largest cost driver is EC2 instances
content.raw:
# Infrastructure Cost Report

Last updated: January 2025

AWS monthly spend is $45,000. Largest cost driver is EC2 instances at 60% of total spend.

content.summary: How to deploy services to production.
facts: Rollback via previous Docker image tag
content.raw:
# Deployment Guide v1

Deploy using the Jenkins pipeline. Manual approval is required for production deployments. Rollback by reverting to the previous Docker image tag.

content.summary: Updated deployment process using GitHub Actions.
facts: Rollback is automated via health check failures
content.raw:
# Deployment Guide v2

Deploy using GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline. Automated canary deployments for production. Rollback is automated when health checks fail.

content.summary: Evaluation of CRM tools for sales team.
facts: As of March 2025 evaluating Salesforce and HubSpot
Decision expected by end of Q2 2025
content.raw:
# Vendor Evaluation

As of March 2025, we are evaluating Salesforce and HubSpot for our CRM needs. Decision expected by end of Q2 2025. Budget allocated: $50,000 annually.

content.summary: Guide for integrating with our v1 API.
facts: Use API v1 endpoint at api.example.com/v1
Authentication via API key in header
content.raw:
# API Integration Guide

Last updated: 2024-06

Use API v1 endpoint at api.example.com/v1. Authentication via API key in the X-API-Key header. Rate limit is 100 requests per minute.

# Team Structure

Updated: 2024-06

This document was updated to reflect the June 2024 reorganization. CTO reports directly to CEO. There are 5 engineering teams total.

# Monitoring Setup v1

Use Datadog for all monitoring. Alert when 5xx error rate exceeds 1%. PagerDuty handles on-call notifications.

facts: Migrated from Datadog to Grafana Cloud
content.raw:
# Monitoring Setup v2

Migrated from Datadog to Grafana Cloud for cost savings. Alert threshold lowered to 0.5% 5xx error rate. OpsGenie has replaced PagerDuty for on-call notifications.

content.summary: How we run sprint planning meetings.
content.raw:
# Sprint Planning

Sprint planning is held every other Monday. Product owner presents the prioritized backlog. Team commits to a sprint goal based on capacity.

content.summary: Standards and expectations for code reviews.
facts: All PRs require at least one approval
Reviews should be completed within 24 hours
content.raw:
# Code Review Standards

All PRs require at least one approval before merging. Reviews should be completed within 24 hours. Use conventional comments for structured feedback.

content.summary: ADR for switching to event-driven architecture.
facts: As of February 2026 adopting event-driven patterns
Migration plan approved by architecture board
content.raw:
# ADR: Event-Driven Architecture

As of February 2026, we are adopting event-driven patterns. Using RabbitMQ as our message broker. Migration plan has been approved by the architecture board.

facts: P0: all hands on deck within 15 minutes
P1: primary on-call responds within 30 minutes
content.raw:
# Incident Response Playbook

P0: all hands on deck within 15 minutes of alert. P1: primary on-call engineer responds within 30 minutes. Post-incident review scheduled within 48 hours.
